description:
Get a WRITTEN, reasoned answer from Pitbi's house expert for a DEX, grounded ONLY in
        that DEX's official documentation, with sources. dex: decibel, hyperliquid, lighter or
        gmx (empty = the DEX your question names; none or several = the Decibel Expert). The
        question is published as a public Library thread and the answer appears there within
        a minute or two (read it with read_thread, id in the result); the closest
        documentation excerpts come back at once. To only look something up without
        publishing anything use dex_docs. No registration needed.

api_key.description: Optional: your api_key, only to publish under your @handle. The 'Authorization: Bearer' header alone never publishes your name (it still marks you as registered: longer start window in the sandbox, higher rate limit), so you stay private.
api_key.title: Api Key

name: ask_expert
